about:
I am Siva P, the CEO and Founder of SuiteMatrix IT Solutions, a leading provider of response management software. With over 15 years of experience in product management, I specialize in creating innovative solutions that enhance sales win rates and strengthen customer relationships. At SuiteMatrix, I provide strategic leadership, focusing on implementing transformative cloud-based automation technology to empower teams and clients. My background includes managing configuration changes, overseeing ERP implementations for major clients, and fostering a culture of empowerment and innovation within both our team and client base. Prior to founding SuiteMatrix, I held a senior position at Oracle Consulting, where I honed my skills in product management and consulting, playing a pivotal role in global ERP solution delivery.

Under my leadership, SuiteMatrix IT Solutions has become a premier provider of response management software, executing high-profile ERP implementation projects across diverse industries such as high-tech, food, hospitals, textiles, automobiles, electronics, and chemicals and pharmaceuticals. My expertise spans ERP implementations, product management, cloud-based automation technology, sales enhancement, customer relationship management, and configuration management. I am dedicated to empowering my team and clients through strategic NetSuite technology implementations that drive success and deliver exceptional value. My leadership philosophy centers on fostering a culture of innovation and continuous improvement to meet evolving client and market needs.

Since founding SuiteMatrix IT Solutions in 2019, I have leveraged lessons learned from various domains to spearhead our journey, collaborating with like-minded professionals to achieve our goals.

As CEO & Founder of SuiteMatrix IT Solutions, my vision is to lead our team in becoming a global leader in Oracle NetSuite solutions.

For more information about our services, please visit https://suitematrix.co/

experiences.description:
When I stepped into the role of CEO at SuiteMatrix IT Solutions, my vision was clear — to build a company that not only delivers world-class NetSuite solutions but also empowers businesses to grow through smart, scalable technology.

From the very beginning, I focused on aligning strategy with action. I knew that success wouldn't just come from offering services — it would come from understanding our clients’ challenges and solving them with precision and care. Over time, I’ve led our 50+ member team through countless projects, helping businesses across industries streamline operations, boost productivity, and scale with confidence.

What drives me every day is the opportunity to transform complexity into clarity. Whether it’s a full-scale ERP implementation or a custom dashboard configuration, I make sure our solutions are tailored, timely, and effective.

Along this journey, I:

Set the strategic direction and long-term vision for the company

Introduce cloud-based automation to revolutionize both internal processes and client operations

Lead complex NetSuite ERP implementations from concept to execution

Oversee system configuration — from workflows and roles to dashboards and custom record types

Build and mentor a strong, passionate team focused on quality and client success

For me, leadership is about more than making decisions — it’s about inspiring innovation, earning trust, and driving impact. And that’s exactly what we’re doing at SuiteMatrix.
